name: acm
description: Terraform module for AWS Certificate Manager, designed to import an existing certificate or request a new certificate to AWS. This module provides a streamlined process for certificate management, ensuring secure and efficient handling of your AWS certificates.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Action to perform. Valid values are 'import' and 'request'

inputs.name: alarm_sns_topics
inputs.description: List of SNS topics triggered by alarm events. providing a list will automatically enable alarm actions

inputs.name: certificate_transparency_logging
inputs.description: Certificate transparency logging preference, only applicable for requested certificates

inputs.name: cloudwatch_tags
inputs.description: Cloudwatch Alarm tags. See https://pages.experian.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=400041906 for all available tags

inputs.name: disable_default_alarms
inputs.description: To disable the best practice AWS alarms as outlined here in [AWS Best Practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Best_Practice_Recommended_Alarms_AWS_Services.html#CertificateManager)

inputs.name: enable_all_alarm_actions
inputs.description: Set to `true` to enable alarm actions for `INSUFFICIENT_DATA` and `OK` state for all default alarms. By default, only `ALARM` states will trigger actions

inputs.name: enable_route53_alarms
inputs.description: Enable Route53 alarms, only applicable for requested certificates

inputs.name: external_domain_validation
inputs.description: Set to `true` if the DNS domain validation is external. See README for more details

inputs.name: import_certificate
inputs.description: Certificate to import in PEM format

inputs.name: request_certificate
route53_recordset_overwrite
inputs.description: Allow overwriting of existing Route53 record set, only applicable for requested certificates

inputs.name: route53_recordset_ttl
inputs.description: TTL for the Route53 record set, only applicable for requested certificates

inputs.name: subject_alternative_names
inputs.description: Subject alternative names for the certificate, only applicable for requested certificates

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags for AWS resources. See https://pages.experian.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=400041906 for all available tags

inputs.name: validation_option
inputs.description: Validation options for the certificate request

outputs.name: domain_name
outputs.description: The domain name of the Certificate.

outputs.name: domain_validation_options
outputs.description: The domain validation options of the Certificate.
